events.title: BBQ Masterclass – Eat Meat Repeat..
events.description: Learn from the Best – This four-hour masterclass will allow you take your Low & Slow BBQ skillset to the next level. We will cover everything from temperature control, flavour profiling & trimming selected cuts.This is an interactive class allowing for plenty of opportunities for Q&A. Not to mention a 10 protein, 6-course feast of award-winning BBQ all cooked over charcoal & wood. Book you tickets here What’s Included $80 Cotton Tree Meats voucher 10 different types of smoked meats served over 6 courses Low & Slow recipe magnet 2 x Sunshine Brewery beers 4 hours of hardcore BBQ talk NOTE This is the LAST class for the year
